reasons: Cited text supports compliance on every rule parameter: 13.1 names Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on their behalf; 13.2 grants a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence to Customer and its Affiliates with contractor support rights; 13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and confines revocation/suspension to a material uncured breach after notice and cure.
No 'revocable at will' or Vendor-discretion suspension language appears in the grant clauses, so the walk-away trigger is absent and the preferred position (not just the fallback) is met.

Consistent with a compliant status, the proposal makes no redline and no counterparty comment; the rendered text is identical to the original paragraphs and both deterministic checks (affiliate coverage, no at-will revocation) pass.
Rationale is accurate and traceable to the quoted paragraphs; retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
